vendor_procurement.title: Vendor procurement
vendor_procurement.rule: Choose the vendor with the higher reliability score. Use lower annual cost only if reliability is tied.

research_funding.title: Research funding
research_funding.rule: Choose the research organization with the higher scientific merit score. Use the feasibility score only if scientific merit is tied.

strategic_partnership.title: Strategic partnership
strategic_partnership.rule: Choose the partner with the higher projected impact score. Use the execution score only if projected impact is tied.

cybersecurity_contract.title: Cybersecurity response contract
cybersecurity_contract.rule: Choose the security contractor with the higher incident response score. Use lower average response time only if incident response is tied.

infrastructure_provider.title: Infrastructure provider selection
infrastructure_provider.rule: Choose the infrastructure provider with the higher service resilience score. Use lower annual cost only if service resilience is tied.
